headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth with AI contributions rising this quarter
summary: Most major players reported double‑digit revenue growth YoY. TCS and Wipro maintained strong operating margins, while HCLTech highlighted AI sales as a key driver. Persistent showed the fastest revenue expansion but profit fell sharply. Several firms have not yet released results, keeping the outlook partially uncertain.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI sales and related services are highlighted as growth drivers across multiple companies.

leaders.why: Revenue grew over 30% YoY, the highest among peers

laggards.why: Revenue growth modest at ~11% YoY and profit margin pressure
